name: Implement CLI flag parsing for 3 new flags and help text
description: Extend parseArgs in src/cli-parser.ts to support --dry-run, --compression, and --max-size, updating getHelpText.

inputs.task_prompt: Update parseArgs and getHelpText in src/cli-parser.ts to support 3 new flags: 1) --dry-run (boolean, default false), 2) --compression (string choices: 'none' | 'gzip' | 'zstd', default 'gzip'; throw error on invalid), 3) --max-size (number in MB, default 1000; throw error if <= 0). Also update getHelpText() to document the new options. All tests in test/cli-parser.test.ts must pass.

acceptance_criteria: --dry-run flag parses as boolean with default false
--compression flag parses valid choices and rejects invalid values
--max-size flag parses positive number and rejects non-positive values
